rules.last_session: PROVISIONAL: touched threads and standalone beats with narrative_impact and lasting_consequence both medium or high; story order; no cap
rules.want: ongoing pursuit; adventure before side, then importance and actionability; serves_thread is null (an end, not a means) and significance is not incidental (Goals: parent_goal_id null, significance not incidental)
rules.owe: definite_end; commitment_type is not general_agreement; stake, burden and consequence are not trivial (Obligations filter)
rules.blocked_by: active, persists beyond the scene, not covered by immediate danger, and blocks a thread holding a shown want, debt or opening
rules.could_use: openings only; supported enabling action toward a shown want/debt; direct role; equivalent offers/plans use validated canonical fact references; assets stay in state/history
rules.unknown: question_type open_ended and all four dimensions medium or high (Mysteries filter)
rules.threat: harm_origin is not party and no evaluation is low (Brewing Troubles filter); not covered by an immediate danger
rules.all: never possibly moot facts; no caps; no assets in open matters

last_session_candidates.change: The party arrived at Brandonsford following a treasure map whose marked locations they did not recognize, in land unknown to them.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The single beat establishes the party's arrival and their map-driven goal, framing the campaign's premise without any discovery about the treasure.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The beat sets up an unfound treasure the party is actively pursuing, which should drive later Sessions.

last_session_candidates.change: Reginald warned that a trickster Clurichen comes from the riverbanks into town every night and should be avoided.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Reginald's warning introduces a new local danger but nothing happened with it yet.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The nightly Clurichen likely ties into the vanishing ale and Sir Phidipaldi's claims, so it is likely to come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned a black dragon is terrorizing Brandonsford and Eric the Reeve offered 1000 gold for its body, though Sir Phidipaldi insulted and challenged Eric.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Eric's 1000-gold bounty, Lady Hilda's offer to join, George's lost arm and Gill's sons hunting the dragon together give the party a major new goal and foe.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The standing bounty, the hireable Hilda and the strained relationship with Eric after the glove slap will shape later Sessions.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned that shipments to Brandonsford have stopped for weeks or months, leaving the town short of goods.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Bentley's overdue shipment, Warwick's empty shop and Quinn's report reveal a town-wide supply problem whose cause is unknown.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The unexplained missing shipments are an open mystery likely tied to the dragon and likely to come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: Drop Dead Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold a week, and Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Ned's murderous hire offer introduces a potential, dangerous ally, but no agreement was made.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Dr. Uriah left the offer open, so Ned may return as hireling or threat.

last_session_candidates.change: Bentley banned Sir Phidipaldi from his tavern for the night, sending him to the Golden Egg while his friends stayed.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Bentley's intervention split the party's lodging for one night after the argument with Eric.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The ejection lasts only the night, though it may color Bentley's view of Sir Phidipaldi.

last_session_candidates.change: Farmer Gill offered Dunk the mule Shamus for 100 gold, and Dunk is considering trading work for it while staying in Gill's barn.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: An offer of an ordinary mount was made and not accepted, a small adjustment.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The pending mule offer and Dunk's lodging with Gill may come up again but are minor.

last_session_candidates.change: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to Quinn's 100-gold deal to stage a fake ale shipment to catch Bentley, whom Quinn blames for his vanishing stock.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Sir Phidipaldi struck a paid agreement with Quinn and planned the water-bottle ruse, clearly changing the situation.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The agreed deal remains to be carried out and pits the party against Bentley, so it will likely shape the next Session.
